name: B10-0288/2025 (ESN) – Media freedom in Georgia, particularly the case of Mzia Amaglobeli
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on media freedom in Georgia, particularly the case of Mzia Amaglobeli
part_text:
This is an opinion, not a change in the law. A group in the European Parliament says Georgia's October 2024 election was free and fair. It defends the arrest of journalist Mzia Amaglobeli, who slapped a police chief, and says her trial is happening amid protests by the opposition. It warns the European Union that supporting efforts to overturn the election result undermines democracy in Georgia. It asks the European Union to stop its confrontational approach and to see the situation as complex.

- Nothing changes in law; this is a stated position only.
- It concerns the European Union's stance towards Georgia and its government.
- It goes to European Union institutions and Georgia's leaders; no action is required.
